title: Cap. V Obj. 2 Sol: more required as instruments for external work than as motives for intention
pass_a_gloss: Solution. For sound Philosophy teaches that more things are required as antecedent instruments for the production of some work in an external act, than are required as antecedent motives for the intention or destination of the same in the mind and will of the one operating. For let me wish to argue thus: The actual building of some house is not more bound than the volition of building the same: But the building itself is bound to the antecedent fitting-together of timbers and stones: Therefore the volition itself is bound to all these as antecedents, and is born from foresight of them. A conclusion inept indeed.
pass_b_english: Sol. Sound philosophy teaches that more is required as antecedent instruments to produce a work in an external act than as antecedent motives for intending or destinating that work in the operator's mind and will. Argue parallel: the actual building of a house is no more bound than the will to build it; but building is bound to the prior fitting of timbers and stones; therefore the will is bound to all those as antecedents and is born from foresight of them. An inept conclusion indeed.
source_text: Sol. Docet enim sana Philosophia, plura requiri tanquam instrumenta praecedanea ad productionem alicujus operis in actu externo, quam requiruntur tanquam antecedanea motiva ad intentionem sive destinationem ejusdem in mente et voluntate operantis. Fac enim me velle ita argumentari: Actualis domus alicujus aedificatio non magis est adstricta, quam ejusdem aedificandae volitio: Sed ipsa aedificatio adstricta est ad praecedaneam coaptationem lignorum et lapidum: Ergo ipsa volitio adstricta est ad haec omnia tanquam antecedanea, et ex illorum praevisione nascitur. Inepta sane conclusio.
